name: Classic Fluffy Pancakes
description: Start your day right with this fresh and flavorful breakfast option. High in nutrients and loaded with taste.
instructions: Gather and prep all ingredients. Finely chop garlic, onions, and any fresh herbs required for the recipe.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients (flour, sugar, baking powder/soda, salt). In a separate bowl, blend the wet ingredients (eggs, melted butter, milk, vanilla).
Gently fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix until just combined; do not overmix. Fold in any final add-ins (like chocolate chips, berries, or nuts).
Pour ladlefuls of batter onto a hot, greased griddle. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, flip, and cook the other side until golden brown (about 2-3 minutes per side).
Remove from heat. Garnish with a dusting of powdered sugar, fresh berries, or a drizzle of warm maple syrup. Serve immediately while hot and enjoy!

instructions: Wash and prepare all fresh ingredients. Chop vegetables and measure out your dressing/seasonings.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the primary ingredients and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned.
Add the remaining core ingredients (Ground beef, Iceberg lettuce, Tortilla bowls) into the pan. Stir well to combine, turning down the heat slightly to avoid burning.
Toss all ingredients together in a large serving bowl. Drizzle with olive oil, lime juice, or the prepared vinaigrette, and toss gently to coat evenly.
Remove from heat. Garnish with fresh herbs (like basil, parsley, or cilantro) and a sprinkle of grated cheese or sea salt. Serve immediately while hot and enjoy!

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: An exquisite noodle dish with complex sweet, savory, and umami layers. Better than takeout!
instructions: Gather and prep all ingredients. Finely chop garlic, onions, and any fresh herbs required for the recipe.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente, reserving 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a separate pan, melt butter or heat oil. Sauté the aromatics, then stir in your base sauce ingredients. Let simmer on low heat for 8-10 minutes to let flavors meld.
Toss the cooked, drained pasta directly into the sauce. Add a splash of the reserved pasta water to emulsify the sauce, tossing over low heat for 2 minutes until glossy.
Remove from heat. Garnish with fresh herbs (like basil, parsley, or cilantro) and a sprinkle of grated cheese or sea salt. Serve immediately while hot and enjoy!
